description.title: iDRR - Integrated Drug Response Resource
contents: dose_response: Raw dose-response measurements (dose, viability) from 15 datasets
metrics: Harmonized drug response metrics per drug-cell pair
drugs: Drug metadata with CID and drug class
drugs/metrics now also carry: moa (mechanism of action), target (gene symbols), moa_source
metrics_description: SEE: Standard Error of Estimate (cross-study consistency)
SLOPE, MAX, MIN: Curve fit parameters
description.annotation_note: MoA and target annotations added 2026-09-17. Primary source: Broad Drug Repurposing Hub (via PRISM Repurposing 20Q2 compound metadata); gaps filled from ChEMBL mechanism records. drug_class is unchanged from v1.0. MoA available for 614/760 compounds, target for 574/760; NA elsewhere.
